name: io.github.sdamarketing/tgcloud-mcp
title: tgcloud — Telegram serverless bots
description: MCP server for Telegram serverless bots: lifecycle, deploys, migrations, webhooks via tgcloud CLI

environmentVariables.name: TGCLOUD_CLI
environmentVariables.description: Command that launches the tgcloud CLI (default npx; may be a proxy wrapper)

environmentVariables.name: TGCLOUD_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout of one CLI command, in milliseconds

environmentVariables.name: TGCLOUD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: CLI access token from @BotFather (form app<id>:<secret>), used instead of tgcloud login
